title: Prism: Efficient Test-Time Scaling via Hierarchical Search and Self-Verification for Discrete Diffusion Language Models
authors_zh: Jinbin Bai、Yixuan Li、Yuchen Zhu、Yi Xin、Qingyu Shi、Aosong Feng、Xiaohong Liu、Molei Tao、Jianru Xue、Xiangtai Li、Ming-Hsuan Yang（机构：新加坡国立大学、Collov Labs、西安交通大学、佐治亚理工学院等）
paper_type_zh: 测试时计算扩展方法研究（ICML 2026）
best_for_zh: 研究离散扩散语言模型、搜索式推理和验证器替代方案的读者。
one_line: Prism allocates denoising-time compute through hierarchical search, partial remasking, and self-verification for discrete diffusion language models.
Prism 以分层搜索、局部重掩码和自验证反馈，为离散扩散语言模型分配更有效的推理计算。
why: It makes the search state, verifier signal, and cost unit explicit for non-autoregressive reasoning inference.
inclusion_reason: It studies how inference-time search, verification, and compute allocation can be adapted and measured for discrete diffusion language models.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Most test-time scaling methods were designed for autoregressive models that extend a response from left to right. Their search trees can score a prefix, keep a promising continuation, or backtrack after an error. A discrete diffusion language model instead repeatedly denoises an entire masked sequence, so an intermediate state is not a normal prefix and repeatedly producing complete independent samples wastes much of the available inference budget.

Prism asks how extra denoising computation can improve mathematical reasoning and code generation without importing an autoregressive search procedure that mismatches the model. The problem is not simply to generate more candidates: the system needs an auditable rule for deciding which partially completed trajectories receive more computation, which uncertain regions are revised, and how a useful score is obtained when an external verifier is unavailable.

大多数测试时扩展方法都为从左到右续写回答的自回归模型而设计。它们的搜索树可以给前缀评分、保留有希望的续写，或在出错后回溯。离散扩散语言模型却会反复对整段掩码序列去噪，因此其中间状态不是普通前缀；若反复生成彼此独立的完整答案，也会浪费大量可用的推理预算。

Prism 研究如何让额外去噪计算改善数学推理和代码生成，而不把与模型不匹配的自回归搜索过程硬搬过来。问题不只是多生成几个候选：系统还必须有可审计的规则，说明哪些半完成轨迹应获得更多计算、哪些不确定区域需要修改，以及在没有外部验证器时如何得到有用的评分信号。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Prism treats a partially denoised sequence as a search state rather than as a failed or unfinished answer. Its Hierarchical Trajectory Search explores broadly during an early-to-middle denoising window, scores intermediate completions, prunes weak states, and shifts subsequent function evaluations toward states that look more promising. This turns a fixed repeated-sampling budget into an adaptive allocation decision.

The framework combines that allocation with two mechanisms tailored to diffusion generation. Self-Verified Feedback asks the same model to evaluate intermediate completions, avoiding a separately trained external verifier. Local branching then partially remasks uncertain content while preserving high-confidence tokens, so candidates can differ where exploration is useful without discarding a promising global draft. The resulting record links state, score, branch, remasking action, and computation cost.

Prism 将半去噪序列看成搜索状态，而不是失败或未完成的答案。它的分层轨迹搜索会在去噪的早中期窗口内广泛探索，对中间完成结果评分、剪除较弱状态，并把后续函数评估转向看起来更有希望的状态。这把固定的重复采样预算转化为一个自适应的计算分配决策。

该框架还结合了两项适配扩散生成的机制。自验证反馈要求同一模型评估中间完成结果，从而避免另行训练外部验证器；局部分支则只重新掩码不确定内容，同时保留高置信度 token，使候选能在值得探索的位置产生差异，而不会丢弃已经有希望的整体草稿。由此形成的记录连接了状态、分数、分支、重掩码动作和计算成本。

title: Method
方法
html:
For each problem, Prism begins from the model's masked denoising trajectory and opens a search window before the sequence is fully resolved. Hierarchical Trajectory Search maintains candidate states in that window. At specified stages it obtains intermediate completions, prompts the model for self-evaluation feedback, uses the resulting signal to rank candidates, and prunes or reallocates the remaining number of function evaluations instead of extending every candidate equally.

When a state deserves another exploration step, local branching preserves tokens the model considers reliable and remasks only a selected region. The diffusion model then refines that region in parallel, producing alternative implementations or solution paths without restarting from an all-mask state. The paper evaluates this procedure on four math-reasoning and code-generation benchmarks with LLaDA 8B Instruct, Dream 7B Instruct, and LLaDA 2.0-mini; correctness or task success is the terminal outcome, while function evaluations are the reported compute unit.

针对每个问题，Prism 从模型的掩码去噪轨迹出发，并在序列完全确定前打开一个搜索窗口。分层轨迹搜索在该窗口中维护候选状态：在指定阶段取得中间完成结果，用提示要求模型给出自我评估反馈，以该信号为候选排序，并剪除或重新分配剩余函数评估次数，而非让每个候选获得相同的延展机会。

当某个状态值得继续探索时，局部分支会保留模型认为可靠的 token，只重新掩码选定区域。扩散模型随后并行细化该区域，在不从全掩码状态重新开始的情况下产生替代实现或解题路径。论文在四个数学推理和代码生成基准上，以 LLaDA 8B Instruct、Dream 7B Instruct 与 LLaDA 2.0-mini 评估该流程；正确性或任务成功是终止结果，函数评估次数则是报告的计算单位。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper evaluates on four mathematical-reasoning and code-generation benchmarks and three discrete diffusion language models: LLaDA 8B Instruct, Dream 7B Instruct, and LLaDA 2.0-mini. Its central comparison is with linear best-of-N style search. The reported conclusion is a performance-efficiency trade-off that matches the best-of-N result while using substantially fewer function evaluations, rather than an accuracy claim detached from inference cost.

The paper's main figure reports matched-performance speedups of 2.9 times on GSM8K, 6.5 times on MATH500, 1.8 times on HumanEval, and 1.7 times on MBPP relative to its stated repeated-search comparison. These are useful task-level results because they cover both math and code, but they measure function evaluations rather than a universal wall-clock cost. The evidence therefore supports efficient allocation under the tested model, decoding, and benchmark configurations, not a general claim about all diffusion or autoregressive systems.

论文在四个数学推理和代码生成基准上，使用三种离散扩散语言模型进行评估：LLaDA 8B Instruct、Dream 7B Instruct 和 LLaDA 2.0-mini。其核心比较对象是线性的最佳候选式搜索。论文报告的关键结论是：在使用显著更少函数评估次数时达到与最佳候选相当的结果，因而强调的是性能与效率的权衡，而非脱离推理成本的准确率主张。

论文主图报告，相对其给出的重复搜索比较，在达到相近性能时，GSM8K 的加速为 2.9 倍，MATH500 为 6.5 倍，HumanEval 为 1.8 倍，MBPP 为 1.7 倍。这些任务层面的结果同时覆盖数学和代码，但衡量的是函数评估次数而不是普适的实际运行时间。因此，证据支持该方法在已测试的模型、解码和基准配置下更有效地分配计算，却不能直接推出它对所有扩散或自回归系统都同样有效。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Closest repeated-sampling approaches spend a complete denoising trajectory on each candidate and normally use an external reward or verifier to choose among finished outputs. Prism changes both decisions for a discrete diffusion model: it makes partially denoised trajectories selectable search states, and it derives an intermediate feedback signal from self-evaluation. Compute can therefore be removed from a weak branch before that branch reaches a final answer.

Its additional change is local branching through partial remasking. Unlike a left-to-right tree that must extend or abandon a prefix, the method keeps high-confidence tokens and reopens only the region whose alternative is worth testing. The contribution is not a new correctness oracle: self-verification may still be wrong. Its direction signal is the explicit, inspectable coupling of a diffusion state, a self-score, a remasking decision, and a function-evaluation budget.

最接近的重复采样方法会让每个候选走完一条完整去噪轨迹，并通常依赖外部奖励模型或验证器在最终输出之间做选择。Prism 为离散扩散模型同时改变了这两个决策：它把半去噪轨迹变成可被选择的搜索状态，并从自我评估中得到中间反馈信号。因此，较弱分支还未抵达最终答案时，计算就可以从该分支撤出。

它进一步通过局部重掩码实现分支。不同于必须延展或放弃某个前缀的从左到右搜索树，该方法保留高置信度 token，只重新打开值得尝试替代方案的区域。其贡献并非提出新的正确性预言机，因为自验证仍可能出错；它的方向价值在于把扩散状态、自评分、重掩码决策与函数评估预算显式且可检查地联系起来。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Prism's self-evaluation signal is produced by the same model whose candidates it ranks, so correlated reasoning errors or confident but incorrect intermediate judgments can misallocate the budget. The results are limited to three discrete diffusion language models and four math/code benchmarks, and the reported cost is function evaluations rather than end-to-end latency or energy. Reuse should therefore test the calibration of self-verification, the remasking policy, and the actual serving cost on the target model and hardware before treating the reported speedups as transferable.
Prism 的自我评估信号由与候选生成相同的模型产生，因此相关的推理错误，或自信却错误的中间判断，都可能把预算分配到错误分支。结果也仅覆盖三种离散扩散语言模型和四个数学或代码基准，报告的成本是函数评估次数而非端到端延迟或能耗。复用前应在目标模型和硬件上检查自验证的校准性、重掩码策略以及真实服务成本，不能把文中加速比直接视作可迁移结论。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: This work is useful when a discrete diffusion model is already available and the deployment question is how to spend a fixed inference budget more selectively, not how to retrain the model. A practical reproduction should log the prompt, denoising stage, candidate identifier, self-evaluation text and score, retained and remasked tokens, pruning decision, function-evaluation count, final answer, and correctness. Those fields make it possible to distinguish a gain from better search allocation from a gain caused merely by running more denoising calls.
当已经拥有离散扩散语言模型，而部署问题是如何更有选择地使用固定推理预算、而不是如何重新训练模型时，这项工作具有直接参考价值。实际复现应记录提示、去噪阶段、候选标识、自我评估文本和分数、保留与重掩码的 token、剪枝决定、函数评估次数、最终答案及正确性。这些字段可区分收益究竟来自更好的搜索分配，还是仅仅来自运行了更多去噪调用。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the paper as a state-allocation study, not only as another best-of-N alternative. First inspect where the early-to-middle denoising window begins and ends, because that choice determines which partially formed text can compete for budget. Then separate the contributions of hierarchical pruning, partial remasking, and self-verification in the ablations. Finally, compare both accuracy and function evaluations at matched budgets, and check whether the released code reproduces the same accounting unit before comparing it with autoregressive test-time methods.
应把这篇论文读成一项状态分配研究，而不只是另一种最佳候选替代方案。先检查早中期去噪窗口的起止位置，因为这一选择决定哪些半成形文本能够竞争预算；再通过消融实验区分分层剪枝、局部重掩码和自验证各自的贡献。最后，在匹配预算时同时比较准确率与函数评估次数，并在同自回归测试时方法比较前，确认公开代码采用的是相同的成本统计单位。
